## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/stringmapentrystorage">StringMapEntryStorage</a> - Holds the value in a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/stringmapentry">StringMapEntry</a>.</p>


<p>Factored out into a separate base class to make it easier to specialize. This is primarily intended to support <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/stringset">StringSet</a>, which doesn't need a value stored at all.</p>
